title: Valid Palindrome
description: Check if a string is a palindrome, ignoring non-alphanumeric characters.

data.text: Given a string `s`, return `true` if it is a palindrome after removing non-alphanumeric characters and ignoring case.

**Input:** `"A man, a plan, a canal: Panama"`

**Output:** `true`

data.title: Clean & Reverse O(n)
Two-Pointer O(n) O(1)
What improved?
data.text: We skip extra allocations. Two pointers compare in place and skip non-alphanumerics on the fly.
